query: Please implement a web application based on Flamego, with functionalities such as user registration, login, browsing, and managing personal information. Users should be able to register an account, log in to the system, browse and manage their personal information, including basic profile, avatar, and password. The system should have routing configuration, parameter passing, and error handling functionalities. Define the background as magenta and components as dark violet.
